consent.public.page: Sevi is a three-minute hearing screen in your browser. It is a screening, not a diagnosis. You must be 18 or older. In voice mode, Gnani processes your spoken answers to turn them into text. Tailscale relays the encrypted connection and cannot read it. Cloudflare carries the connection only while our backup link is on. Our own server hosts this page. We delete our copy of your answers after 72 hours. We do not ask for your name or phone number.
consent.study.page: This is the Sevi study station. A team member will guide you. It is a screening, not a diagnosis. You must be 18 or older. Cloudflare carries the connection only while our backup link is on. Our own server hosts this page. We delete our copy of your answers after 72 hours.
disclaimer.page: Sevi is a screening, not a diagnosis. A pass does not rule out hearing loss. This test plays the sound to both ears together, so it cannot check each ear separately or high pitches. If in doubt, see an audiologist.
evon.template.explain: This test checked how clearly you heard spoken digits in background noise, using phone-quality audio. It is a screening only, not a full medical examination; if you are worried about your hearing, see an audiologist or an ear, nose and throat doctor.
share.card: Three numbers are hidden in the noise. Can you hear them? A free hearing screen in your browser, with phone-quality audio. A screening, not a diagnosis.
